title: 'Profile cannot be loaded' error when Outlook opens
description: I restarted my computer, and Outlook won't open anymore. Error: 'The set of folders cannot be opened'.

worklogs.description: The profile was corrupted; a new profile was created via Control Panel > Mail.
Waited for the Cached Mode sync; the mailbox (3.5 GB) was fully downloaded.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: The new profile is ready. Once the sync completes, you'll see all your emails.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: All the emails came back, and the calendar is synced too. Thank you.

resolutionNote: A new Outlook profile was created, and Cached Mode re-synced all the data. No data loss.

csat.comment: Quick fix, no loss, very happy.
